name: Tobetsu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tobetsu town emblem in navy and white: a navy disc bearing a white stylised swirl, like a letter C.
history: Municipal flag of Tobetsu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 28 October 1969.

features.role: Tobetsu town emblem — a navy disc bearing a white stylised swirl, like a letter C
